free_apis.name: Alpha Vantage
free_apis.notes: Works with demo key, but limited rate. Free API key available with registration.

free_apis.name: ECB Statistical Data Warehouse
free_apis.notes: Free, no API key needed. Returns SDMX-ML format. Documentation: https://data.ecb.europa.eu/help/api/overview

free_apis.name: Bank of England Statistical Interactive Database API
free_apis.notes: Free, no API key needed. Series code IUDBEDR is the Official Bank Rate. Returns CSV format.

free_apis.name: No Free API Available
free_apis.notes: Bank of Japan does not provide a free public API. Data available at https://www.boj.or.jp/en/statistics/index.htm but requires manual download or web scraping.
free_apis.alternative: Use static JSON or web scraping

free_apis.name: Bank of Canada Valet API
free_apis.notes: Free, no API key needed. V39079 is the policy interest rate series. Documentation: https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/docs

free_apis.name: RBA Statistical Tables
free_apis.notes: Free Excel file download. Table F1 contains Cash Rate Target. No JSON API available - requires parsing Excel file.
free_apis.alternative: Use static JSON or parse Excel file

fully_working_no_key: US (Alpha Vantage with demo key - limited rate)
requires_registration: US (FRED API - free but needs key)
no_free_api: AUD (Reserve Bank of Australia - only Excel files)
summary.recommendation: Use static JSON for reliable, maintenance-free solution. Central bank rates change infrequently (monthly meetings), making static data practical.

implementation_notes.alpha_vantage: Rate limited with demo key. Request free key at https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
implementation_notes.ecb: Returns SDMX-ML (XML) format - requires XML parsing
implementation_notes.bank_of_england: Returns CSV format - requires CSV parsing
implementation_notes.bank_of_canada: Best structured API - returns clean JSON
implementation_notes.bank_of_japan: No API - would require web scraping
implementation_notes.rba: Excel files only - would require openpyxl library
